response.sql: WITH patient_averages AS (SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, AVG(l.ALB) AS avg_alb, AVG(CASE WHEN l.`T-BIL` <> 0 THEN CAST(l.UN AS REAL) / l.`T-BIL` END) AS avg_ratio FROM Patient AS p JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID WHERE p.SEX IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(p.SEX) <> '' GROUP BY p.ID, p.SEX), sex_averages AS (SELECT SEX, AVG(avg_alb) AS avg_alb, AVG(avg_ratio) AS avg_ratio FROM patient_averages GROUP BY SEX), overall_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_alb) AS mean_alb FROM sex_averages) SELECT s.SEX, s.avg_alb, s.avg_ratio, s.avg_alb - m.mean_alb AS alb_above_mean FROM sex_averages AS s CROSS JOIN overall_mean AS m WHERE s.avg_alb > m.mean_alb;
